assertions.assertion: The appeal concerns CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry)

The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities
The denial is authorization-based (required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered)
